allocation.heading: Allocation Recipients
allocation.description: Browse public Cosmic Signature allocation history across finalized Performance Cycles, including Signature Allocations, Stellar Selection, Anchor Distributions, and public-goods flows.

finalizedCycles.label: Finalized Cycles
finalizedCycles.tooltip: The number of Performance Cycles with finalized allocation data.

recipients.label: Signature Allocation Recipients
recipients.tooltip: Distinct wallets that received the Signature Allocation by making the Final Gesture.

totalEth.label: Total Signature Allocation ETH
totalEth.tooltip: The sum of Signature Allocation ETH across finalized cycles, based on cycle records.

totalGestures.label: Total Gestures
totalGestures.tooltip: The cumulative number of gestures made across all finalized cycles.

anchoring.heading: Anchor Distributions
anchoring.description: Track public Cosmic Signature NFT anchoring, ETH Anchor Distribution records, RandomWalk NFT anchoring, and Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection imprints.

ethDeposits.label: ETH Anchor Distribution Deposits
ethDeposits.tooltip: ETH deposits into the Anchor Distribution for anchored Cosmic Signature NFTs. Each deposit is shared among the NFTs anchored when it is made.

stellarImprints.label: Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection Imprints
stellarImprints.tooltip: Cosmic Signature NFTs imprinted for anchored RandomWalk NFTs through Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection.

marketing.heading: Outreach Allocations
marketing.description: Review Cosmic Signature outreach allocation history and CST distributions for ecosystem contributors who help people discover the protocol.
marketing.source: Cosmic Signature public outreach allocation APIs

imprint.heading: Imprint Random Walk NFT
imprint.description: Imprint Random Walk NFTs for Cosmic Signature participation. Each unused Random Walk NFT can be attached to one ETH gesture for a 50% Gesture Cost reduction.
imprint.source: Cosmic Signature public protocol configuration APIs

eth-contribution.heading: Direct ETH Contributions
eth-contribution.description: Browse direct ETH contributions to the Cosmic Signature Cycle Reserve and the public notes, cycles, and contributor records attached to them.

links.reserve: How the Cycle Reserve is split
links.protocol: Where the Public Goods share goes

attached-nfts.heading: Attached NFT Contributions
attached-nfts.description: Browse NFTs attached to Cosmic Signature gestures. Attached ERC-721 tokens forward to the participant who receives the Signature Allocation when a cycle finalizes.
attached-nfts.source: Cosmic Signature public attached NFT APIs

links.learn: Learn how attachments fit the cycle

allocation-finalized.heading: Retrieved Allocations
allocation-finalized.description: Inspect public allocation retrieval records from Cosmic Signature, including ETH receipts, Cosmic Signature NFT allocations, and Stellar Selection distributions.
allocation-finalized.source: Cosmic Signature public allocation retrieval APIs

records.label: Allocation Records
records.tooltip: Every allocation record across finalized cycles, including ETH, CST and NFT allocations.

eth.label: ETH Allocated
eth.tooltip: The sum of Signature Allocation, Chrono-Warrior, Stellar Selection and Anchor Distribution ETH across finalized cycles. CST and NFT allocations are not included.

named-nfts.heading: Named Cosmic Signature NFTs
named-nfts.description: Browse Cosmic Signature NFTs that owners have given custom names, connecting token identity, gallery discovery, and on-chain collection history.

used-rwlk-nfts.heading: Used RandomWalk NFTs
used-rwlk-nfts.description: Review RandomWalk NFTs that have already been attached to ETH gestures for their one-time Gesture Cost reduction.
used-rwlk-nfts.source: Cosmic Signature public RandomWalk usage APIs

coordination-changes.heading: Coordination Changes
coordination-changes.description: Review public Cosmic Signature coordination changes, including protocol mode changes, parameter updates, and administration records that affect future cycles.
coordination-changes.source: Cosmic Signature public system event APIs

parameters.label: Parameters Changed
parameters.tooltip: How many distinct protocol parameters these records change. Only the contract owner can change them.

public-goods-contributions-cg.heading: Protocol Public-Goods Contributions
public-goods-contributions-cg.description: Track automatic Cosmic Signature public-goods forwards from protocol cycles to the Public Goods Vault and its configured beneficiary — currently Protocol Guild.

share.label: Share of Each Cycle Reserve
share.tooltip: The share of each finalized Cycle Reserve that the protocol forwards to the Public Goods Vault.

public-goods-contributions-voluntary.heading: Voluntary Public-Goods Contributions
public-goods-contributions-voluntary.description: Browse voluntary public-goods contributions from the Cosmic Signature community, including cycle context and contributor records.

public-goods-retrievals.heading: Public Goods Retrievals
public-goods-retrievals.description: Review retrievals from the Cosmic Signature Public Goods Vault, where cycle reserves forward support to the configured public-goods beneficiary — currently Protocol Guild.

beneficiary.label: Latest Beneficiary
beneficiary.tooltip: The address that received the most recent retrieval from the Public Goods Vault. The configured beneficiary is currently Protocol Guild.

gallerySummary.heading: Cosmic Signature Gallery
gallerySummary.description: Explore Cosmic Signature NFT artwork generated from deterministic three-body physics, on-chain seeds, spectral rendering, and Performance Cycle data. Each Signature is reproducible from protocol records and represents a specific cycle context.

currentCycleSummary.heading: Current Cosmic Signature Performance Cycle
currentCycleSummary.description: Follow the active Cosmic Signature Performance Cycle: gestures, the Cycle Reserve, attached assets, allocation tracks, and finalization status. The display below updates with live protocol data.

info.gestures: Total gestures made in this cycle. Each gesture is also a Stellar Selection entry.
info.signatureAllocation: ETH portion of the Signature Allocation retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture. The recipient also receives 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

app.protocolDescription: Cosmic Signature is a procedural on-chain art protocol on Arbitrum. Every gesture shapes the cycle’s final Signature, and the protocol distributes its reserves across more than ten allocation tracks — including Protocol Guild.
